notes:
THE FFT EXAMPLE. FFT16/32/64 were all verified bit-exact on chip and NONE had a runnable example — nothing to open, nothing to demonstrate. examples/fft_spectrum is a live spectrum analyzer on the fabric: x16_in -> FFT -> ComplexToMagSquared -> x16_out, so the transform AND the per-bin power both run on chip; the flowgraph un-reverses the DIF bin order and plots a natural-order spectrum. TWO sizes ship as independent .kyt/.grc pairs: N=64 (FFT64Block, 84 FFT cells, 104/120 with routing) and N=32 (FFT32Block, 60 cells, 80/120). FFT16 was NOT shipped — FFT32 covers the smaller-variant requirement and exercises the same CHIP_SCALE pinned-placement lesson, whereas FFT16 is an ordinary folded block that would demonstrate less.

THE POINT OF THIS RECORD: every headless gate was GREEN while the USER PATH was BROKEN, three separate times, each producing a plausible-looking wrong spectrum. (1) A hosted batch's I/Q lands on the CLIENT's default data_addrs=(0,1) unless the burst names a stream_id the server resolved; this chain lands on [1,2], so I went to register 0 and Q to register 1, the block saw a REAL input, and the tone split into two quarter-power peaks at bins 11 and 53 (measured: two 6635 words instead of one 26539). (2) A repeat-burst source re-arms mid-vector, so each later burst starts at an arbitrary ROTATION of the stimulus — for a framed transform that slides the frame grid (measured: a 55-sample rotation moved the peak from slot 52 to 43). Fixed with the CW/PSK31 shape: repeat=no on the source, server_repeat=yes on the sink. (3) The host clips full-scale input — _float_to_q15 uses min(0.999, f), so 32767/32768 lands as word 32735 (8 samples of a 255-sample burst). The demo drives amplitude 0.9, where the server's conversion and the example's reference agree on EVERY sample, which is what lets the user-path gate demand bit-exactness rather than a tolerance.

PLACEMENT: a CHIP_SCALE block cannot be auto-packed — auto_pnr shifts the verified 12-row ctl/out spine off the array ('cell (2,12) is off the 10x12 array'); the placer has no CHIP_SCALE awareness anywhere. The working shape is PIN THE ANCHORS, AUTO-ROUTE EVERYTHING ELSE. Two measured details: the 1-cell power stage's resting face must be NORTH at (9,1) (the default EAST points off-array and the egress net dies with 'no bus path from source to the broker tap'), and the FFT->power link must be ONE connection because add_logical_connection synthesises the Q-half sibling — adding it by hand too creates a duplicate net that routes, builds, and emits A FRAME OF PURE ZEROS with no error anywhere.

HARNESS: a user-path suite that 'bound something' is more dangerous than one that failed to bind. start_gnuradio_server returned None while another session held 58950, and the flowgraph then talked to THAT server — the suite analysed somebody else's chip output (304215 words of a foreign stream) and reported it as a spectrum defect. _serve now retries until it holds 58950 ITSELF and asserts the exclusive bind; new user-path suites should copy that rather than the bare 'assert bound == _PORT'.

VERIFIED: 26 gates. Both user-path gates green — shipped .kyt hosted exactly as the GUI does, shipped .grc GRC-generated and run under the real GNU Radio interpreter. OBSERVED SPECTRUM, N=64: bin 11 at -0.9 dBFS with all 63 other bins at the -90.0 dBFS floor; N=32: identical at 32 bins. Both sizes bit-exact on the real built chip (255/255 and 127/127 power words) against the FFT streaming reference composed with the power stage's. Coverage adds a bin sweep (1,5,11,23,32,47,63), a two-tone case that must show exactly two lines, a noise case that must NOT concentrate in one bin, the three pinned contracts (bit-reversed order, FFT/N scale, N-1 latency), and six mutations that must FAIL — the load-bearing one being NO UN-REVERSAL, since the raw bit-reversed slots are a clean, plausible, wrong spectrum.

NOT VERIFIED: nothing was run in the actual placeKYT GUI (no display server); the user path was exercised through the same hosted-server harness the GUI's 'Run as GNURadio Server' uses, and the QT vector sink was never pixel-probed. FFT16 has no example. The three live-path defects above are EXAMPLE-SIDE fixes — the underlying server behaviours (client default data_addrs, the 0.999 input clamp) were left untouched and may affect other chained examples.
